result:
Implemented Phase 3 (§5 Transcribe/Speech) of SPEC.md:

- **`app/components/Transcribe.vue`** — wired to `SFSpeechRecognizer`: authorization request/status mapped to the exact required labels, `Transcribe Sample` runs an `SFSpeechURLRecognitionRequest` against the bundled file with partial results streaming live into the transcript area, and on completion shows the final transcript plus a `Completed in N.N s` line (wall-clock from tap to final result). Errors surface in the status line per the general rule; the button re-enables on failure.
- **`app/assets/sample.wav`** — copy of `spec-assets/sample.wav` placed under `app/assets/` so `@nativescript/vite`'s built-in static-copy picks it up and bundles it into the app (`spec-assets/` itself untouched); loaded at runtime via `knownFolders.currentApp().path + '/assets/sample.wav'`.
- **`App_Resources/iOS/Info.plist`** — added `NSSpeechRecognitionUsageDescription`, required for the authorization prompt.
- **`types/references.d.ts`** — added a reference to the Speech framework's iOS type defs (mirroring the existing HealthKit reference) so `SFSpeechRecognizer` etc. type-check.

`ns build ios` succeeds, and I installed/launched the built app on an iOS 26 simulator to confirm it starts and stays running without crashing.
